title: Use of Medium Frequency Electrotherapy in the Treatment of OAB, LUTS and Pelvic Pain
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to assess the effectiveness of medium frequency electrotherapy (interferential currents) treatment for overactive bladder (OAB), lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS) and pelvic pain
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Increased bladder sensation Urgency Overactive bladder Lower urinary tract symptoms Pelvic pain

Exclusion Criteria:

Neurogenic bladder Acute urinary infection Pelvic floor surgery Congenital urological malformations Age less than 18 years Bladder organic pathology Pelvic radiotherapy
